content_sections.heading: DIAT Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the DIAT Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download DIAT Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Assistant (PA): MBA (Operations, Finance). Desirable: Knowledge of business development, Statistics and statistical software SPSS, Minitab. Analyst: MBA (Logistics & Supply Chain Management) with minimum one year industry experience. Desirable: Knowledge of ERP Systems, Inventory & Stock Control, Logistics planning.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 28 years for all posts. Age Relaxation: Up to 05 years for SC/ST, Women & PwBD and 03 years for OBC (NCL).

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Project Assistant (PA): ₹20,000/- (consolidated) Per Month Analyst: ₹30,000/- (consolidated) Per Month

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DIAT Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DIAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the DIAT Project Assistant (PA) & Analyst posts is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant (PA) & Analyst posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by the Defence Institute of Advanced Technology (DIAT) for the Project Assistant (PA) and Analyst positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: For Project Assistant (PA), an MBA in Operations or Finance is required. For the Analyst post, an MBA in Logistics & Supply Chain Management with at least one year of industry experience is necessary.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the DIAT recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 28 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant and Analyst roles?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant (PA) will receive a consolidated salary of ₹20,000/- per month, while the Analyst will be paid ₹30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the DIAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email by sending their resume and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) to apply for the DIAT Project Assistant (PA) & Analyst positions.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these contractual positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will primarily involve an interview, which may be conducted in-person or via video conferencing.

faq.question: Q9. Where is DIAT located?
faq.answer: The Defence Institute of Advanced Technology (DIAT) is located in Pune, Maharashtra, with the pincode 411025.

faq.question: Q10. Does the notification mention any desirable qualifications?
faq.answer: Yes, for Project Assistant (PA), knowledge of business development and statistics is desirable. For the Analyst post, knowledge of ERP Systems and logistics planning is desirable.
